capabilities: display a yearly writing heatmap with per-date statistics
show live word and note counts in the status bar
import or exclude Markdown files and folders from tracking
stamp created dates on new notes for cross-device date stability
extras: Bilingual documentation (Simplified Chinese and English); manual installation from GitHub Releases; requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later; statistics stored locally in data.json with no telemetry; the listing is marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view of writing activity over time, so it is hard to see daily and monthly writing output without leaving the app.
summary: Local writing statistics plugin that shows a yearly heatmap, monthly word-count trends, and live word counts in a sidebar and status bar.
